description: Shared emoji picker popup. Renders a search input, categorised emoji grid, and optional Remove button. Positioning is relative to the nearest positioned ancestor — callers must provide that context.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Fired when the user clicks "Remove icon".

parameters.name: OnRemoved
parameters.description: Fired when the user clicks an emoji. Arg = the emoji character string.

parameters.name: ShowRemoveButton
parameters.description: Fired when the backdrop is clicked (close without action).
